options.meaning: Select CLI API independently of the executable release version.
Print this frozen baseline contract without reading input or rules.
Print the short human guide without reading input or rules.
Print the complete human guide without reading input or rules.
Print lumtail followed by its executable release version.
Report the active host/runtime protection policy.
Fail before processing without the required native production policy.
List formats in detection order; nonterminal output is NAME TAB PRIORITY LF.
Load rules document version 1 in argument order.
Force a named format; unrecognized records fall back to plain text.
Select the record representation.
Compile an explicit text layout; always override a preset.
Select a text layout; JSON and raw output are unaffected.
Control text severity colors.
Choose ordered parsing workers.
Follow exactly one named regular file, including rotation.
Emit available records without waiting for an input batch.
Keep this normalized severity and higher; exclude UNKNOWN.
Keep ERROR and CRITICAL.
Require event_type=alert, combined with other filters using AND.
Require event_type=authentication and outcome=failure.
Match an exact case-sensitive FIELD=VALUE; missing fields do not match.
Compile exact, prefix and numeric comparisons with NOT, AND, OR and parentheses.
Choose physical lines or indentation-based logical records.
Bound physical line bytes; reject oversize input explicitly.
Bound assembled multiline record bytes.
Flush an idle indented record after this many milliseconds.
Select bounded agent JSON Lines; incompatible explicit output is an error.
Select up to 16 literal context keys for agent output.
Stop after N matching logical records globally, in input order.
Bound live-input reading by an elapsed-time deadline; arbitrary blocking output has no hard deadline.
Bound encoded agent string content, plus one shared selected-fields budget.
Bound agent message and selected-field lines.

arguments.numeric_values: decimal, positive, representable on the host; documented narrower ranges apply

exit_status.0: Successful processing, including zero matches, an intentional limit/deadline stop, or a downstream EPIPE. Not a security verdict.
exit_status.1: Input, output, runtime protection or processing failure; completed output can precede an error.
exit_status.2: Invalid invocation, unknown module or invalid rules/configuration.

filters.missing: comparisons are false, including !=; NOT can negate that false value
filters.prefix: one trailing * with ~; equality treats * literally
filters.numbers: exact decimal comparison; no floating-point rounding
filters.boundaries: file, line, format and raw are record metadata; filters see complete values before clipping

outputs.raw: Input record bytes after existing CRLF/newline normalization; no colors or terminal escaping.
outputs.text: Terminal-safe record text; explicit templates/presets have frozen placeholder and missing-field semantics.

json.framing: one compact UTF-8 JSON object per LF-terminated physical line
json.fields: open dictionary; existing documented field meanings are preserved

agent.framing: one compact UTF-8 JSON object per LF-terminated physical line
agent.bounds: explicit truncated/truncated_fields; no split UTF-8 sequence or JSON escape
agent.missing: null; distinct from an empty string

outputs.unicode: Text escapes terminal controls. JSON replaces invalid UTF-8 with U+FFFD and escapes controls, Unicode line separators and direction controls.

allowed: New opt-in flags and values that preserve existing valid invocations.
New format names and previously unrecognized producer profiles; automatic recognition is extensible.
New dictionary keys without repurposing existing documented keys.
not_frozen: Host-dependent sandbox report values, file error descriptions and automatic worker count.
Performance, wall-clock scheduling, OS availability and C++ ABI.
extensions.incompatible: Requires a new explicitly selected CLI API; API 1 and its default selection remain supported.
